changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Group') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Group]( ID int IDENTITY(1,1) not null, Name nvarchar(250) not null, Description nvarchar(max) null, PrimaryOwnerResourceID int null, SecondaryOwnerResourceID int null, IsActiveDirectoryGroup bit constraint DF_Group_IsActiveDirectoryGroup default(0) not null, UpdatedOn datetime null, UpdatedBy int null, CONSTRAINT PK_Group PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT ucGroupName UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Name] ASC ) ) END
